title: "censored_competing_plot"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
# this code was generated with the help of ChatGPT o4 mini high
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Original data (English labels)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_obs <- data.frame(
  patient = c("Patient 1", "Patient 2", "Patient 3", 
              "Patient 4", "Patient 5", "Patient 6"),
  start   = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
  end     = c(10, 20, 30, 10, 30, 5),
  event   = c("Discharge", "Death", "Censored", 
              "Discharge", "Censored", "Death")
)

df_ext <- data.frame(
  patient = c("Patient 4", "Patient 5"),
  start   = c(10, 30),
  end     = c(20, 40),
  event   = c("Death", "Death")
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Swap old Patient 3 ↔ old Patient 4
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
swap_labels <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(x == "Patient 3", "TMP", x)
  x <- ifelse(x == "Patient 4", "Patient 3", x)
  x <- ifelse(x == "TMP",       "Patient 4", x)
  x
}

df_obs$patient <- swap_labels(df_obs$patient)
df_ext$patient <- swap_labels(df_ext$patient)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Rename the event labels to German
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
rename_event <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x == "Death", "Tod",
         ifelse(x == "Censored", "Zensiert",
                ifelse(x == "Discharge", "Entlassen", x)))
}

df_obs$event <- rename_event(df_obs$event)
df_ext$event <- rename_event(df_ext$event)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Adjust endpoints:
#     - If a patient has the event "Entlassen" on day 10, change that to day 12.
#     - If a patient has the event "Tod" on day 20, change that to day 25.
#     - Additionally, change the death event of Patient 3 (in df_ext) to day 25.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_obs$end[df_obs$event == "Entlassen" & df_obs$end == 10] <- 12
df_obs$end[df_obs$event == "Tod" & df_obs$end == 20] <- 25
df_ext$end[df_ext$patient == "Patient 3" & df_ext$event == "Tod" & df_ext$end == 20] <- 25

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Analysis color logic
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_obs$analysis <- ifelse(df_obs$event == "Zensiert",
                          "Nicht Berücksichtigt",  # darkgrey
                          "Berücksichtigt")        # black
df_ext$analysis <- "Nicht Berücksichtigt"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Override color logic for specific segments => analysis2
#    (makes Patient 4 + first arrow of Patient 5 black; 
#     though we will remove Patient 4 soon, shown here for completeness)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_obs$analysis2 <- with(
  df_obs,
  ifelse(
    patient == "Patient 4" | (patient == "Patient 5" & end == 30),
    "Berücksichtigt",
    ifelse(event == "Zensiert", "Nicht Berücksichtigt", "Berücksichtigt")
  )
)

df_ext$analysis2 <- df_ext$analysis

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Remove Patient 4 entirely from the data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_obs <- subset(df_obs, patient != "Patient 4")
df_ext <- subset(df_ext, patient != "Patient 4")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Rename Patient 5 -> 4 and Patient 6 -> 5
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert to character so we can modify in place
df_obs$patient <- as.character(df_obs$patient)
df_obs$patient[df_obs$patient == "Patient 5"] <- "Patient 4"
df_obs$patient[df_obs$patient == "Patient 6"] <- "Patient 5"

df_ext$patient <- as.character(df_ext$patient)
df_ext$patient[df_ext$patient == "Patient 5"] <- "Patient 4"
df_ext$patient[df_ext$patient == "Patient 6"] <- "Patient 5"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Define new factor levels for the updated patient labels
#    Now we have: Patient 1,2,3,4,5 (since old Patient 4 is removed)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ascending_levels <- c("Patient 1", "Patient 2", "Patient 3", "Patient 4", "Patient 5")
df_obs$patient <- factor(df_obs$patient, levels = ascending_levels)
df_ext$patient <- factor(df_ext$patient, levels = ascending_levels)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Split intervals at day=9: from 0-9 => forced grey, after 9 => old logic
#     We'll store the new color in "analysis3"
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
split_segments <- function(df) {
  out <- data.frame()
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    row <- df[i, ]
    st  <- row$start
    en  <- row$end
    
    # The old color logic (black/grey) is in "analysis2"
    old_col <- row$analysis2
    
    if (en <= 9) {
      # Entire segment is within [0,9]
      row$analysis3 <- "Initial (0-9)"
      out <- rbind(out, row)
    } else if (st >= 9) {
      # Entire segment is after 9
      row$analysis3 <- old_col
      out <- rbind(out, row)
    } else {
      # st < 9 < en => split into two segments
      row1 <- row
      row1$end       <- 9
      row1$analysis3 <- "Initial (0-9)"
      
      row2 <- row
      row2$start     <- 9
      # row2$end remains the same
      row2$analysis3 <- old_col
      
      out <- rbind(out, row1, row2)
    }
  }
  out
}

df_obs2 <- split_segments(df_obs)
df_ext2 <- split_segments(df_ext)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Plot using "analysis3" for line color and add labels to the dotted lines
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
censored_competing_plot <- ggplot() +
  # Extended lines
  geom_segment(
    data = df_ext2,
    aes(x = start, xend = end, y = patient, yend = patient, color = analysis3),
    size = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), ends = "last", type = "closed")
  ) +
  # Observed lines
  geom_segment(
    data = df_obs2,
    aes(x = start, xend = end, y = patient, yend = patient, color = analysis3),
    size = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), ends = "last", type = "closed")
  ) +
  # Manual color scale: "Initial (0-9)" is plotted but hidden in legend
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Modellierung",
    values = c(
      "Initial (0-9)" = "darkgrey",
      "Berücksichtigt" = "black",
      "Nicht Berücksichtigt" = "darkgrey"
    ),
    breaks = c("Berücksichtigt", "Nicht Berücksichtigt")  # hide "Initial (0-9)"
  ) +
  # Endpoints (still from original df_obs, df_ext)
  geom_point(
    data = df_obs,
    aes(x = end, y = patient, fill = event),
    shape = 21, color = "black", size = 3
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df_ext,
    aes(x = end, y = patient, fill = event),
    shape = 21, color = "black", size = 3
  ) +
  # Fill scale for endpoints
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Ereignis",
    values = c("Entlassen" = "darkblue", "Tod" = "red", "Zensiert" = "purple")
  ) +
  # Event labels
  geom_text(
    data = df_obs,
    aes(x = end, y = patient, label = event),
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 4, color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = df_ext,
    aes(x = end, y = patient, label = event),
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 4, color = "black"
  ) +
  # Dotted lines at day 9 and day 30 with labels
  geom_vline(xintercept = 9,  linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 30, linetype = "dotted") +
  # Add horizontal labels to the vertical lines
  annotate("text", x = 9, y = 5.5, label = "Tag 9", angle = 0, vjust = -0.5, size = 4, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 30, y = 5.5, label = "Tag 30", angle = 0, vjust = -0.5, size = 4, color ="black") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 50)) +
  labs(x = "Tag", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  # Reverse so "Patient 1" is top
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(ascending_levels)) +
  expand_limits(y = length(ascending_levels) + 1)

# Save the plot as a PNG file
#ggsave("censored_competing_plot.png", plot = censored_competing_plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
